what: Plan wires larch_quiet_append_done_trap on both wrapper and inner denylisted children that share one LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL export
scenario_or_breakage: Child EXIT can touch the done sentinel and unblock breadcrumb-monitor before the outer wrapper process exits; a later parent trap can overwrite LARCH_STATUS_FILE with a different code
suggested_fix: Install the done trap only on the backgrounded top-level denylisted PID per launch (wrapper OR direct child), not on both nested scripts in the same invocation chain
